name: 36582 · Theodore, AL
findings: ZIP 36582 (Theodore) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36582 (Theodore) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36582 (Theodore) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
